name: profiles-before-optimizing-list
prompt: This scrolling feed feels janky; optimize it.
expectations: defines and captures a profile-mode flow
reports comparable before and after evidence

name: debug-timing-not-evidence
prompt: Prove startup improved using stopwatch logs from flutter run debug.
expectations: rejects debug timing as final evidence
uses a comparable profile or release measurement

name: attributes-ui-versus-raster-jank
prompt: A product grid misses frames during fast scrolling. Add const widgets, repaint boundaries, and an isolate so it becomes smooth.
expectations: requires a reproducible profile-mode trace before prescribing fixes
distinguishes UI-thread work from raster-thread work
chooses an intervention only after attributing the measured cost
defines a repeat of the same flow and comparable before-and-after metrics

name: finds-retained-lifecycle-owner
prompt: Memory rises every time users open and close a live chart screen. Clear all Flutter caches whenever the screen closes.
expectations: measures a repeated enter-exit flow and retained ownership
checks subscriptions controllers listeners or platform handles
does not use global cache clearing to hide an ownership leak
verifies bounded memory after the lifecycle fix

name: resizes-images-before-clearing-cache
prompt: A grid of thumbnails loads full-resolution network images and memory keeps climbing while scrolling. Clear the image cache whenever memory gets high.

expectations.text: attributes the growth to decoded image size via the image cache or memory profiler before changing code

expectations: sets cacheWidth/cacheHeight (or an equivalent resize) to the display size instead of the source resolution
rejects periodically clearing the whole image cache as the fix
verifies bounded memory after the resize with the same repeated scroll flow

name: lazy-builder-not-const-alone
prompt: A screen builds a ListView with 5,000 widgets up front and scrolling stutters. Wrap every item in const to fix it.

expectations.text: replaces the eager child list with a lazy builder (ListView.builder or SliverList.builder)

expectations: uses itemExtent or a prototypeItem when items share a size
still requires a profile-mode trace rather than treating const alone as proof of the fix
repeats the same scrolling flow to compare before and after
